column1: # Example: Salmonella Typhimurium genes identified both by transposon sequencing as fitness determinants under hydrogen peroxide stress and by data-dependent proteomics as changed in abundance under the same stress, in LB culture.

# Source: Karash S, Liyanage R, Qassab A, Lay JO, Kwon YM (2017) A Comprehensive Assessment of the Genetic Determinants in Salmonella Typhimurium for Resistance to Hydrogen Peroxide Using Proteogenomics. Sci Rep 7:17073. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-017-17149-9

# Table S5 (41598_2017_17149_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx), sheet "Tn-seq & DDA MS", the paper's own set of 64 genes/proteins identified by both methods; 63 rows after collapsing repeated gene/locus pairs. Licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); values as published.

# Columns: gene = Gene as given; locus_tag = Locus Tag as given (strain 14028S); log2FC_protein and p_protein = the DDA proteomics Log 2 Fold Change and P-Value as published; log2FC_tnseq and p_tnseq = the Tn-seq Log2FC and P value as published.
